text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Mozambican government has postponed voter registration scheduled to begin next Monday because the necessary funds have not yet been disbursed by foreign donors. There is now a consensus that the date of December 27 proposed for the country's first municipal elections is impractical, and they will have to be postponed into 1998.
- Police in the northern province of Cabo Delgado have seized 11 tonnes of hashish, smuggled into the country by sea. Three men have been arrested in connection with the case.
- Sudanese President Omar El-Bashir paid a brief visit to Maputo yesterday and asked President Joaquim Chissano to play a bigger role in the search for a solution to the Sudanese civil war.
